explain.de: Subject pronouns do the action (I, he). Object pronouns come after the verb or a preposition (me, him). Possessive adjectives say who owns something (my, his). Possessive pronouns stand alone (mine, his).
explain.ku: جهێناڤێن کارا کارەکی دکەن (I، he). جهێناڤێن بەرکار پشتی کاری یان پێشگری دهێن (me، him). my، his = یێ کێ (دگەل ناڤی). mine، his = ب تنێ.

examples.de: She is my sister. I love her.
examples.ku: ئەو خویشکا منە. ئەز حەز ژ وێ دکەم.

examples.de: This is our car. It is ours.
examples.ku: ئەڤە ترومبێلا مە یە. یا مە یە.

tip.de: I is always a capital letter. his = of him, her = of her.
tip.ku: I هەردەم ب پیتا مەزن. his = یێ وی، her = یێ وێ.

explain.de: The verb “to be” has three forms in the present: am, is, are. I → am. He, she, it → is. You, we, they → are.
explain.ku: کارێ «to be» (بوون) سێ شێوە هەنە: am، is، are. I ← am. He / she / it ← is. You / we / they ← are.

tip.de: Don't forget the verb: “I am a student”, not “I a student”.
tip.ku: کاری ژ بیر نەکە: «I am a student»، نە «I a student».

explain.de: Questions: put am/is/are first: Are you OK? Negative: add not: I am not tired. She isn't here.
explain.ku: بۆ پرسیارێ: am/is/are دهێتە دەستپێکێ: Are you OK? بۆ نەرێنیێ: not زێدە بکە: I am not tired. She isn't here.

examples.de: Are you tired? – No, I'm not.

practice.q: Make it negative: She is at school.

more.de: Is she a doctor? – Yes, she is.

explain.de: Wh- words ask for information: what, where, who, when, how, how old. The verb comes after the question word: Where are you from?
explain.ku: پەیڤێن Wh- پێزانینان دپرسن: what (چ)، where (ل کیڤە)، who (کی)، when (کەنگی)، how (چەوا)، how old (چەند سالی). کار پشتی پەیڤا پرسیارێ دهێت.

examples.de: How are you? – I'm fine, thanks.

explain.de: Use a before a consonant sound (a book) and an before a vowel sound (an apple). Use the when we know which one: the book on the table.
explain.ku: a بەری دەنگەکێ نەدەنگدار (a book) و an بەری دەنگدارەکێ (an apple). the دەمێ ئەم دزانین کیژ تشتە: the book on the table.

head: example
rows: a car, a house, a university
an egg, an orange, an hour
the sun, the door, the teacher

tip.de: “a university” (the sound is “you”), “an hour” (h is silent).

more.de: I have a car. The car is red.
more.ku: ترومبێلەک من هەیە. ترومبێل یا سۆرە.

explain.de: Most nouns add -s: book → books. After s, sh, ch, x add -es: box → boxes. Consonant + y → -ies: baby → babies. Some are irregular: man → men, child → children.
explain.ku: پتریا ناڤان ‎-s وەردگرن: book ← books. پشتی s، sh، ch، x ‎-es: box ← boxes. نەدەنگدار + y ← ‎-ies: baby ← babies. هندەک نە ل سەر یاسایێ نە: man ← men، child ← children.

title.ku: یێ من، یێ تە، یێ وی…

explain.de: Possessive adjectives show who has something: I → my, you → your, he → his, she → her, it → its, we → our, they → their.
explain.ku: ئەڤ پەیڤە نیشان ددەن کا تشت یێ کێیە: I ← my، you ← your، he ← his، she ← her، it ← its، we ← our، they ← their.

explain.de: this / these = near me. that / those = far from me. this and that are singular, these and those are plural.
explain.ku: this / these = نێزیک. that / those = دویر. this و that تاکن، these و those کۆنە.

explain.de: Use have for I, you, we, they. Use has for he, she, it. Question: Do you have …? Does she have …?
explain.ku: have بۆ I، you، we، they. has بۆ he، she، it. پرسیار: Do you have …? Does she have …?

examples.de: Do you have a car? – No, I don't.

practice.a: No, she doesn't have a phone.

more.de: Does she have a phone? – Yes, she does.

explain.de: We use the present simple for habits and facts. With he, she, it add -s: I work → she works. go → goes, watch → watches, study → studies.
explain.ku: بۆ کار و رەوشتێن هەر رۆژ و ڕاستیان بکاردئینین. دگەل he، she، it ‎-s زێدە دبیت: I work ← she works. go ← goes، watch ← watches، study ← studies.

examples.de: She goes to school by bus.

practice.q: What time do you get up?
practice.a: I get up at seven o'clock.

tip.de: He, she, it → don't forget the -s!
tip.ku: دگەل he، she، it ‎-s ژ بیر نەکە!

more.de: My father drinks coffee every morning.
more.ku: بابێ من هەر سپێدە قەهوێ ڤەدخوت.
ئەو رۆژێن ئەینیێ تەپا پێ یاری دکەن.

explain.de: Negative: don't / doesn't + verb (no -s): She doesn't like tea. Question: Do / Does + subject + verb: Do you speak English?
explain.ku: نەرێنی: don't / doesn't + کار (بێ ‎-s): She doesn't like tea. پرسیار: Do / Does + کەس + کار: Do you speak English?

examples.de: Does he speak Kurdish? – Yes, he does.
examples.ku: ئەرێ ئەو ب کوردی دئاخڤیت؟ – بەلێ.

practice.q: Make a question: you / like / coffee
practice.aku: ئەرێ تو حەز ژ قەهوێ دکەی؟

practice.q: Make it negative: He plays football.

more.de: Do you speak English? – Yes, I do.
more.ku: ئەرێ تو ب ئینگلیزی دئاخڤی؟ – بەلێ.

explain.de: at + clock time (at 8 o'clock). on + day/date (on Monday). in + month, year, part of the day (in May, in the morning). But: at night.
explain.ku: at + دەمژمێر (at 8 o'clock). on + رۆژ/رێکەفت (on Monday). in + هەیڤ، سال، پشکێن رۆژێ (in May، in the morning). بەلێ: at night.

head: example
rows: in June, in 2025, in the evening

examples.ku: رۆژبوونا من د ئادارێ دا یە.

practice.q: When do you get up? (7 o'clock)

more.de: I get up at six o'clock.
We go to the park on Sunday.

explain.de: Frequency words go before the main verb but after “be”: I always get up early. She is never late.
explain.ku: پەیڤێن چەند جاران بەری کاری دهێن، بەلێ پشتی «be»: I always get up early. She is never late.

examples.de: I always drink tea in the morning.

examples.ku: ئەو جار جار تەپا پێ یاری دکەت.

practice.q: How often do you drink coffee? (always)

more.ku: ئەز پتریا جاران ب پێیان دچمە کاری.

explain.de: There is + singular: There is a bed. There are + plural: There are two chairs. Question: Is there …? Are there …?
explain.ku: There is + تاک: There is a bed (تەختەک هەیە). There are + کۆ: There are two chairs (دوو کورسی هەنە). پرسیار: Is there …? Are there …?

examples.de: There is a park near my house.

more.de: There is a cat in the garden.
There are two chairs in the room.
more.ku: دوو کورسی د ژوورێ دا هەنە.

more.de: Are there any shops near here?

explain.de: Prepositions of place: in (inside), on (on top of), under, next to, behind, in front of, between.
explain.ku: ئامرازێن جهی: in (د ناڤ دا)، on (ل سەر)، under (ل بن)، next to (ل تەنیشت)، behind (ل پشت)، in front of (ل بەر)، between (د ناڤبەرا).

head: example
rows: between the bank and the café

examples.de: The keys are on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The café is next to the bank.

practice.q: Where is the pharmacy? (next to / bank)

more.de: My phone is in my bag.
more.ku: مۆبایلا من د جانتا من دا یە.

more.de: The picture is on the wall.
The shoes are under the chair.

explain.de: Use the base verb to give instructions: Open the door! Turn left. Negative: Don't + verb: Don't run!
explain.ku: بۆ ڕێنمایی شێوێ سەرەکی یێ کاری بکاربینە: Open the door! (دەرگەهی ڤەکە!) Turn left. نەرێنی: Don't + کار: Don't run!

examples.de: Go straight on and turn left.
examples.ku: راستەوخۆ بچە و بەرەف چەپێ بزڤڕە.

practice.q: Tell your friend: open / the window
Tell your friend: not / be late

explain.de: can + base verb for ability: I can swim. Negative: can't. Question: Can you …? can is the same for all persons (no -s).
explain.ku: can + کار بۆ شیانێ: I can swim (ئەز دشێم مەلەڤانیێ بکەم). نەرێنی: can't. پرسیار: Can you …? can بۆ هەمی کەسان وەکی ئێکە (بێ ‎-s).

head: example
rows: Can you swim? – Yes, I can.

examples.ku: ئەز دشێم ب سێ زمانان باخڤم.

more.ku: ئەو دشێت گەلەک باش مەلەڤانیێ بکەت.

explain.de: After like, love, hate we often use verb + -ing: I like reading. She loves cooking. I don't like running.
explain.ku: پشتی like، love، hate پتریا جاران کار + ‎-ing دهێت: I like reading (ئەز حەز ژ خواندنێ دکەم). She loves cooking.

examples.ku: ئەز حەز ژ یاریا تەپا پێ دکەم.
ئەو گەلەک حەز ژ چێکرنا خوارنا کوردی دکەت.
ئەرێ تو حەز ژ سەمایێ دکەی؟

practice.qku: ئەرێ ئەو حەز ژ مەلەڤانیێ دکەت؟
ئەرێ ئەو حەز ژ چاڤەڕێکرنێ دکەن؟

more.ku: ئەو حەز ژ خواندنا پەرتووکان دکەت.
ئەم گەلەک حەز ژ گەشتکرنێ دکەین.

title.de: some / any, How much / How many
title.ku: some / any — How much / How many

explain.de: some in positive sentences, any in negatives and questions. How many + countable (apples). How much + uncountable (water, money).
explain.ku: some د رستێن ئەرێنی دا، any د نەرێنی و پرسیاران دا. How many + تشتێن دهێنە هژمارتن (apples). How much + یێن ناهێنە هژمارتن (water، money).

examples.de: How much is it? – Five dollars.

practice.q: ___ apples do you want? (How many / How much)
practice.a: How many apples do you want?

practice.q: ___ water do you drink? (How many / How much)
practice.a: How much water do you drink?

more.de: How many brothers do you have?
How much water do you drink?

explain.de: For things happening now: am / is / are + verb-ing. I am reading. She is cooking now. Are you working?
explain.ku: بۆ تشتێن نوکە دبن: am / is / are + کار-ing. I am reading (ئەز یێ دخوینم). She is cooking now. Are you working?

examples.de: What are you doing? – I'm cooking.
examples.ku: تو چ دکەی؟ – ئەز خوارنێ چێدکەم.

practice.q: What are you doing now? (read / a book)

tip.de: Every day → present simple. Now → present continuous.
tip.ku: هەر رۆژ ← present simple. نوکە ← present continuous.

explain.de: The past of be: I / he / she / it → was. You / we / they → were. Negative: wasn't / weren't.
explain.ku: دەمێ بۆری یێ be: I / he / she / it ← was. You / we / they ← were. نەرێنی: wasn't / weren't.

examples.ku: تو دوهی شەڤێ ل کیڤە بووی؟

more.ku: ئەرێ تو دوهی ل قوتابخانێ بووی؟

explain.de: Regular verbs add -ed: work → worked, play → played. Many verbs are irregular: go → went, have → had, eat → ate, see → saw. Negative/question: didn't / Did + base verb.
explain.ku: کارێن ل سەر یاسایێ ‎-ed وەردگرن: work ← worked. گەلەک کار نە ل سەر یاسایێ نە: go ← went، have ← had، eat ← ate، see ← saw. نەرێنی/پرسیار: didn't / Did + کارێ سەرەکی.

examples.de: I watched a film last night.
We went to Duhok on Friday.
Did you see Poya? – No, I didn't.

practice.q: What did you do yesterday? (play / football)
Where did she go? (to the market)

more.de: I didn't go to work yesterday.

explain.de: After a verb or preposition we use object pronouns: I → me, he → him, she → her, we → us, they → them. Call me! I like her.
explain.ku: پشتی کاری یان ئامرازی جێناڤێن بەرکار دهێن: I ← me، he ← him، she ← her، we ← us، they ← them. Call me! I like her.

practice.qku: ئەرێ تو حەز ژ هوودایێ دکەی؟

explain.de: Short adjectives: -er than / the -est: big → bigger → the biggest. Long adjectives: more / the most: more expensive. Irregular: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst.
explain.ku: هەڤاڵناڤێن کورت: ‎-er than / the ‎-est: big ← bigger ← the biggest. یێن درێژ: more / the most. نە ل سەر یاسایێ: good ← better ← the best، bad ← worse ← the worst.

examples.de: She is the best student in the class.

practice.q: Which is bigger? (an elephant / a cat)
practice.a: An elephant is bigger than a cat.

more.de: My brother is taller than me.

explain.de: Plans: am/is/are going to + verb: I'm going to visit my aunt. Quick decisions and predictions: will + verb: I'll help you. It will rain.
explain.ku: بۆ پلانان: am/is/are going to + کار: I'm going to visit my aunt. بۆ بڕیارێن ب لەز و پێشبینیان: will + کار: I'll help you (دێ هاریکاریا تە کەم).

head: example
rows: We are going to travel in summer.

examples.ku: خەم نەخۆ، ئەز دێ تەلەفۆنێ بۆ تە کەم.

practice.q: What are you going to do tomorrow? (visit / my parents)
practice.a: I'm going to visit my parents.
practice.aku: ئەز دێ سەرا دایک و بابێن خۆ دەم.

more.de: We're going to visit our grandmother.
more.ku: ئەم دێ سەرا داپیرا خۆ دەین.
ئەز هزر دکەم ئەو دێ ب سەرکەڤیت.
